title: Splunk Identified SSL TLS Certificates
author: Michael Haag, Splunk
description: The following analytic identifies the usage of Splunk default SSL/TLS certificates within the environment. It leverages tags such as SSL, TLS, and certificate to detect these default certificates by examining the ssl_issuer_common_name field. This activity is significant because using default certificates can expose the environment to potential security risks, as they are not unique and can be easily exploited. If confirmed malicious, attackers could intercept or manipulate data, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches. It is recommended to replace default certificates with valid, unique TLS certificates to enhance security.
